text: Places the ship can reach from the colony and come home from: a few days out, a few days back.

kinds.name: Derelict
kinds.text: A ship adrift, dead or near enough. Whatever she carried may still be aboard, and so may whoever got there first.

kinds.name: Wreck field
kinds.text: What is left of ships that met here once: plating, crates and the odd part still whole.

kinds.name: Ore rock
kinds.text: A rock with metal in it, near enough to reach and small enough to dig by hand.

kinds.name: World
kinds.text: Another of the system's worlds, never settled. What grows there, or fell there, is anyone's.
